name: DrivePanel
description: Your own lightweight Google Drive at home, made for the Raspberry Pi and any small home server. In English and Spanish.
short_desc: Your own lightweight Google Drive at home.
author: IA Online Apps

form_fields.label: Allow account requests
form_fields.hint: If enabled, anyone can request an account and the administrator approves it. If disabled, only the administrator creates accounts. The first user who registers always becomes the administrator.
